title: Interactive SQL Mastery & Database Systems
description: Production database engineering covering basic queries, multi-table joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, and indexing.
outcomes: Master fundamental to advanced concepts in Interactive SQL Mastery & Database Systems.
Build industry-standard applications and capstone projects.
Excel in technical interviews and competitive programming.

modules.title: Relational Database Foundations & SQL Basics
modules.description: RDBMS concepts, tables, rows, columns, primary keys, foreign keys, SQL dialect overview, and basic SELECT syntax.

modules.title: Filtering & Sorting Queries (WHERE, ORDER BY, DISTINCT)
modules.description: WHERE clause, comparison operators, logical operators (AND, OR, NOT), ORDER BY ascending/descending, LIMIT, and DISTINCT values.

modules.title: SQL Operators & Pattern Matching (LIKE, IN, BETWEEN, NULL)
modules.description: Wildcards (% and _) with LIKE/ILIKE, IN and NOT IN lists, BETWEEN ranges, and IS NULL / IS NOT NULL handling with COALESCE.

modules.title: Aggregate Functions & Grouping (GROUP BY & HAVING)
modules.description: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX aggregations, GROUP BY single and multiple columns, and filtering aggregated groups with HAVING.

modules.title: Relational Joins Mastery
modules.description: INNER JOIN, LEFT (OUTER) JOIN, RIGHT (OUTER) JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN, CROSS JOIN, and self-joins with alias handling.

modules.title: Subqueries & Nested Queries
modules.description: Single-row subqueries, multi-row subqueries (IN, ANY, ALL), correlated subqueries, EXISTS, and NOT EXISTS clauses.

modules.title: String, Date & Mathematical Functions
modules.description: String manipulation (CONCAT, SUBSTRING, LENGTH, UPPER, LOWER), date calculations (NOW, DATEADD, DATEDIFF, EXTRACT), and numeric roundings.

modules.title: Views, Indexes & Query Optimization
modules.description: Creating and managing Views, clustered vs non-clustered B-Tree indexes, EXPLAIN query plans, and query performance tuning.

modules.title: Advanced SQL: Window & Analytic Functions
modules.description: OVER() clause, PARTITION BY, ORDER BY frames, ROW_NUMBER(), RANK(), DENSE_RANK(), NTILE(), LAG(), and LEAD().

modules.title: Common Table Expressions (CTE) & Recursion
modules.description: Non-recursive CTEs with WITH clause, multiple CTEs, recursive CTEs for hierarchical organizational trees and graph querying.

modules.title: Transactions, ACID Properties & Concurrency
modules.description: Transaction lifecycle, COMMIT, ROLLBACK, SAVEPOINT, ACID guarantees, dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, phantom reads, and isolation levels.

modules.title: Real-World Database Case Studies & Drills
modules.description: E-commerce order analytics, user churn cohorts, financial balance audits, and FAANG SQL interview question sets.
